name: fDivergence
stmt: noncomputable def fDivergence (f : ℝ → ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ a, p a * f (q a / p a)

name: mul_div_self
stmt: lemma mul_div_self (a b : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) : b * (a / b) = a
proof:
by
  rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hb]

name: fdiv_nonneg_of_convex
stmt:
theorem fdiv_nonneg_of_convex {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) f) (hf1 : f 1 = 0)
    (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ q a)
    (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) :
    0 ≤ fDivergence f p q
proof:
by
  have hxmem : ∀ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)), q a / p a ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro a _
    exact div_nonneg (hq0 a) (le_of_lt (hp0 a))
  have hjen : f (∑ a, p a • (q a / p a)) ≤ ∑ a, p a • f (q a / p a) :=
    hconv.map_sum_le (t := Finset.univ) (w := fun a => p a) (p := fun a => q a / p a)
      (fun a _ => le_of_lt (hp0 a)) hpsum hxmem
  have hleft : ∑ a, p a • (q a / p a) = 1 := by
    have h1 : ∀ a : Fin k, p a • (q a / p a) = q a := by
      intro a
      rw [smul_eq_mul]
      exact mul_div_self (q a) (p a) (ne_of_gt (hp0 a))
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => h1 a)]
    exact hqsum
  have hright : ∑ a, p a • f (q a / p a) = fDivergence f p q := by
    unfold fDivergence
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [smul_eq_mul]
  calc
    0 = f 1 := hf1.symm
    _ = f (∑ a, p a • (q a / p a)) := by rw [hleft]
    _ ≤ ∑ a, p a • f (q a / p a) := hjen
    _ = fDivergence f p q := hright

name: chiSq
stmt: noncomputable def chiSq (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: fDivergence (fun t => (t - 1) ^ 2) p q

name: chiSq_nonneg
doc:
χ² 散度非负：逐项 p_a ≥ 0 与平方 ≥ 0 直接得（也由 `fdiv_nonneg_of_convex` 得，
此处给出不依赖凸性引理名的直接证明）。
stmt: theorem chiSq_nonneg (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) : 0 ≤ chiSq p q
proof:
by
  unfold chiSq fDivergence
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => mul_nonneg (hp0 a) (sq_nonneg _))

name: tv
doc: 全变差型散度：D(p‖q) = Σ_a p_a·|q_a/p_a − 1|。
stmt: noncomputable def tv (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: fDivergence (fun t => |t - 1|) p q

name: tv_nonneg
doc: 全变差非负：逐项非负直接得。
stmt: theorem tv_nonneg (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) : 0 ≤ tv p q
proof:
by
  unfold tv fDivergence
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => mul_nonneg (hp0 a) (abs_nonneg _))

name: kl_as_fdiv
stmt:
theorem kl_as_fdiv (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) :
    fDivergence (fun t => t * Real.log t) q p = kl p q
proof:
by
  rw [kl_as_sum_log_ratio p q hp0 hq0]
  unfold fDivergence
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  calc
    q a * ((p a / q a) * Real.log (p a / q a))
        = (q a * (p a / q a)) * Real.log (p a / q a) := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = p a * Real.log (p a / q a) := by
          rw [mul_div_self (p a) (q a) (ne_of_gt (hq0 a))]

name: kl_fdiv_nonneg
doc: KL 实例的 f-散度非负（由 `kl_nonneg` 直接转写）。
stmt:
theorem kl_fdiv_nonneg (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) :
    0 ≤ fDivergence (fun t => t * Real.log t) q p
proof:
by
  rw [kl_as_fdiv p q hp0 hq0]
  exact kl_nonneg p q hp0 hpsum hq0 hqsum

end Lattice

name: score
stmt: noncomputable def score (p : ℝ → Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (a : Fin k) : ℝ
proof: deriv (fun t => Real.log (p t a)) θ

name: fisherInfo
doc: Fisher 信息（一维参数）：F(θ) = Σ_a p_θ(a)·score_p,θ(a)²。
stmt: noncomputable def fisherInfo (p : ℝ → Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ a, p θ a * (score p θ a) ^ 2

name: fisher_nonneg
stmt:
theorem fisher_nonneg (p : ℝ → Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p θ a) :
    0 ≤ fisherInfo p θ
proof:
by
  unfold fisherInfo
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => mul_nonneg (hp a) (sq_nonneg _))

name: score_log_derivative
stmt:
theorem score_log_derivative (p : ℝ → Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (a : Fin k) (hpos : 0 < p θ a)
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t => p t a) θ) :
    deriv (fun t => p t a) θ = p θ a * score p θ a
proof: log_derivative_identity (fun t => p t a) θ hpos hd

name: fisher_score_mean_zero
stmt:
theorem fisher_score_mean_zero (p : ℝ → Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hsum : ∀ t, ∑ a, p t a = 1)
    (hpos : ∀ a, 0 < p θ a)
    (hd : ∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t => p t a) θ) :
    ∑ a, p θ a * score p θ a = 0
proof:
by
  have hconst : (fun t : ℝ => ∑ a, p t a) = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
    funext t
    exact hsum t
  have hderiv0 : deriv (fun t : ℝ => ∑ a, p t a) θ = 0 := by
    rw [hconst]
    simp
  have hsumderiv : deriv (fun t : ℝ => ∑ a, p t a) θ
      = ∑ a, deriv (fun t : ℝ => p t a) θ :=
    deriv_sum (u := Finset.univ) (A := fun a (t : ℝ) => p t a)
      (by intro a _; exact hd a)
  have hper : ∀ a, deriv (fun t : ℝ => p t a) θ = p θ a * score p θ a :=
    fun a => score_log_derivative p θ a (hpos a) (hd a)
  rw [hsumderiv] at hderiv0
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hper a)] at hderiv0
  exact hderiv0

name: fisher_equals_second_derivative
stmt:
theorem fisher_equals_second_derivative (p : ℝ → Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p θ a)
    (hsecond : ∀ a, deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => Real.log (p s a)) t) θ
        = deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => p s a) t) θ / p θ a - (score p θ a) ^ 2)
    (hsum_second : ∑ a, deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => p s a) t) θ = 0) :
    fisherInfo p θ
      = -∑ a, p θ a * deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => Real.log (p s a)) t) θ
proof:
by
  have hterm : ∀ a, p θ a * deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => Real.log (p s a)) t) θ
      = deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => p s a) t) θ - p θ a * (score p θ a) ^ 2 := by
    intro a
    rw [hsecond a]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (hp a)]
  have hS3 : ∑ a, p θ a * deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => Real.log (p s a)) t) θ
      = ∑ a, (deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => p s a) t) θ
          - p θ a * (score p θ a) ^ 2) :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hterm a)
  have hsplit : ∑ a, (deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => p s a) t) θ
        - p θ a * (score p θ a) ^ 2)
      = ∑ a, deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => p s a) t) θ
        - ∑ a, p θ a * (score p θ a) ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib
  unfold fisherInfo
  linarith [hS3, hsplit, hsum_second]

name: naturalGradient
stmt: noncomputable def naturalGradient (F g : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: g / F

name: quad_complete_square
doc: 配方法（二次型的完全平方）。
stmt:
lemma quad_complete_square (F g v : ℝ) (hF : F ≠ 0) :
    g * v - (F / 2) * v ^ 2 = g ^ 2 / (2 * F) - (F / 2) * (v - g / F) ^ 2
proof:
by
  field_simp [hF]
  ring

name: quad_at_naturalGradient
doc: 自然梯度处的二次型值。
stmt:
lemma quad_at_naturalGradient (F g : ℝ) (hF : F ≠ 0) :
    g * (naturalGradient F g) - (F / 2) * (naturalGradient F g) ^ 2 = g ^ 2 / (2 * F)
proof:
by
  unfold naturalGradient
  field_simp [hF]
  ring

name: natural_gradient_maximizes_quadratic
doc:
自然梯度是 Fisher 度量下二次型的最速下降方向：
F > 0 时 v* = g/F 最大化 v ↦ g·v − (F/2)·v²。
g = −∇J 时「最大化 g·v − (F/2)v²」即「最小化 ∇J·v + (F/2)v²」，
即 Fisher 度量 ‖v‖²_F = F·v² 下的最速下降。
stmt:
theorem natural_gradient_maximizes_quadratic (F g : ℝ) (hF : 0 < F) :
    ∀ v : ℝ,
      g * v - (F / 2) * v ^ 2
        ≤ g * (naturalGradient F g) - (F / 2) * (naturalGradient F g) ^ 2
proof:
by
  intro v
  have hFne : F ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hF
  rw [quad_complete_square F g v hFne, quad_at_naturalGradient F g hFne]
  have hnn : 0 ≤ (F / 2) * (v - g / F) ^ 2 :=
    mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (le_of_lt hF) (by norm_num)) (sq_nonneg _)
  linarith

name: natural_gradient_maximizes_quadratic_iff
doc: 最速下降刻画的等号情形：二次型取到最大值 ⟺ v 恰是自然梯度 v* = g/F。
stmt:
theorem natural_gradient_maximizes_quadratic_iff (F g : ℝ) (hF : 0 < F) (v : ℝ) :
    (g * v - (F / 2) * v ^ 2
        = g * (naturalGradient F g) - (F / 2) * (naturalGradient F g) ^ 2)
      ↔ v = naturalGradient F g
proof:
by
  have hFne : F ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hF
  have hF2 : (F / 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [quad_complete_square F g v hFne, quad_at_naturalGradient F g hFne]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hmul : (F / 2) * (v - g / F) ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
    have hsq : (v - g / F) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hmul with h1 | h2
      · exact absurd h1 hF2
      · exact h2
    have hv : v - g / F = 0 := pow_eq_zero hsq
    unfold naturalGradient
    linarith
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    unfold naturalGradient
    ring

name: fisher_cramer_rao
stmt:
theorem fisher_cramer_rao (p : ℝ → Fin k → ℝ) (T : Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p θ a)
    (hd : ∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t => p t a) θ)
    (hscore : ∑ a, p θ a * score p θ a = 0)
    (hderivT : deriv (fun t => ∑ a, p t a * T a) θ
      = ∑ a, deriv (fun t => p t a) θ * T a)

    1 ≤ fisherInfo p θ * ∑ a, p θ a * (T a - θ) ^ 2

          - ∑ a, p θ a * score p θ a * θ := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      ring

      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      ring
    rw [hsplit, h1, htheta, hscore, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  have hcs := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq (s := Finset.univ)
    (f := fun a => Real.sqrt (p θ a) * score p θ a)
    (g := fun a => Real.sqrt (p θ a) * (T a - θ))
  have hx : ∑ a, Real.sqrt (p θ a) * score p θ a * (Real.sqrt (p θ a) * (T a - θ)) = 1 := by
    have hper : ∀ a, Real.sqrt (p θ a) * score p θ a * (Real.sqrt (p θ a) * (T a - θ))
        = p θ a * score p θ a * (T a - θ) := by
      intro a
      rw [show Real.sqrt (p θ a) * score p θ a * (Real.sqrt (p θ a) * (T a - θ))
          = (Real.sqrt (p θ a) * Real.sqrt (p θ a)) * (score p θ a * (T a - θ)) by ring,
        Real.mul_self_sqrt (l
